newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Caffaro Q1 97 sales, pretax slip.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Caffaro Q1 97 sales, pretax slip.

text.p: Italian chemical company Caffaro SpA, part of the Fiat group, said it posted first quarter 1997 consolidated turnover of 267 billion lire, down 6.8 percent on the same 1996 period.
Pre-tax profit fell to seven billion lire from 21 billion, the company said in a statement after a shareholders meeting to approve 1996 results.
The company said it will pay an unchanged ordinary dividend of 100 lire.
In 1996, Caffaro, which is part of Fiat's Snia Bpd, posted consolidated net profit of 51.6 billion lire against 51.2 billion on sales of 1.025 trillion lire, up 11.1 percent.
Parent company net profit was 29.9 billion lire in 1996 against 7.5 billion in 1995.
